name: tia_get_db_member_attributes
description: Read the V21-reported attributes of one exact direct member of a global DB. Nested member paths and dedicated datatype/revision fields are not returned.

member_name.description: Exact name of a direct member in the selected global DB; nested member paths are unsupported.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact DB block-group path, required when the DB name is duplicated. Use an empty string for the root group.
